lines.text: Ezekiel sees water flowing from under the temple threshold toward the east, and it trickles out from the south side.
The man measures with a line, and the water rises from ankle-deep to knee-deep to chest-deep.
The man leads Ezekiel back to the bank, where he sees a great number of trees on both sides.
The river flows down into the Arabah and empties into the Red Sea, and the water there becomes fresh.
The swamps and marshes will be left for salt, while fruit trees along both banks bear fruit each month.
